teaser: A folded map, still creased from the last trip, rides in your back pocket most days. You are a life path 5 crossed with an ISFP, and what shows up is a hunger for the unmarked road, felt in the hands before it reaches the plans. The 5 wants variety for its own sake; the ISFP wants a moment to feel true before it gets explained. Neither one argues about whether to go. The argument, when there is one, is about how soon, and how close the exit needs to stay.
